locator.section: 9.3 Aldehydes and ketones (lower structure, arrow labelled 'i')

evidence.curator_note: FIFTH channel. The page draws the distonic rH intermediate of IMS9-EQ9.26d a SECOND time, directly below it and joined to it by a vertical DOUBLE-HEADED arrow, in its other localisation: the O-H is drawn as a plain single bond to a NEUTRAL oxygen and the '+' is printed on the carbonyl carbon (C2), with the radical dot still on C5. The two drawings are the standard C(+)-OH <-> C=O(+)H resonance pair of an oxygen-stabilised cation -- one species, two localisations -- and this record uses the one the page actually draws the arrow FROM, per convention C. PRECURSOR is therefore written [C+:2]([O:9][1H:10]) with charge on carbon and a neutral hydroxyl, NOT the [C:2]=[O+:9][1H:10] form used in IMS9-EQ9.26d; both are m/z 128 and the same ion. Book draws 1 arc, the ONLY curved arrow anywhere in Equation 9.26: its tail sits on the C3-C4 bond and its head points AT the '+' on C2. Move <1> encodes it as that bonding pair entering the FORMING C2=C3 bond -- a disclosed reading, since the drawn head lands on the cationic ATOM rather than on the bond, which is the same idealisation IMS9-EQ9.22 records for its ring-contraction arc and the only reading that produces the drawn enol. It is a full two-electron arrow (the step is labelled 'i' and the precursor's charge site is even-electron), so electron_count is 2 and no fishhook is implied. RESULT -- the complementary McLafferty product: the charge stays with the HYDROCARBON, giving the distonic C5H10+. ion the page labels 'm/z 70' (drawn with both a radical dot AND a '+'), while the oxygen leaves as the neutral acetone enol CH2=C(OH)CH3. Together with IMS9-EQ9.26d this is the classic 58/70 charge-retention pair from one rearranged intermediate. MS CONTEXT: the page prints no ionisation conditions, so 70 eV EI is the corpus house default, disclosed rather than read off the page. Figure 9.9 (printed p247) is the 6-methyl-2-heptanone spectrum and does carry abundances, but it is NOT this page and this scheme prints no percentage, so per convention F no relative_intensity is recorded; peaks are status 'proposed'.
